entities.name: Mauritz von Wiktorin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mauritz von Wiktorin was an Austrian general in the Wehrmacht during World War II. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany. Wiktorin was discharged from the army on 30 November 1944 after the 20 July Plot.
